name: Doxy.me vs Thera-LINK
title: Doxy.me vs Thera-LINK: Telehealth Platforms for Therapists Compared
description: Compare Doxy.me and Thera-LINK - two popular HIPAA-compliant telehealth platforms for mental health professionals. See differences in pricing, features, and therapy-specific design.

summary.bottom_line: Doxy.me offers a permanent free tier ideal for budget-conscious solo practitioners, while Thera-LINK is a mental health-specific platform designed by therapists with customizable waiting rooms featuring calming content. Both are browser-based with no client downloads required.

sections.heading: Doxy.me vs Thera-LINK: Overview
sections.content: Doxy.me and Thera-LINK are both HIPAA-compliant, browser-based telehealth platforms that require no downloads for patients. Doxy.me is a general healthcare telehealth solution used by over 1.5 million providers across specialties, known for its permanent free tier. Thera-LINK was designed specifically by and for therapists, featuring customizable waiting rooms with calming content and integration with popular therapy EHRs.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Doxy.me's main advantage is its permanent free tier with full HIPAA compliance and BAA included - often sufficient for solo practitioners. Paid plans start at $29/month (annual) for features like HD video and screen sharing. Thera-LINK starts at $35/month with no free tier, but includes HD video, screen sharing, and mental health-specific features on all plans. For group practices, pricing is comparable at $35-50/provider/month.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: Thera-LINK's differentiator is its therapy-specific design: customizable waiting rooms that can display calming content for anxious clients, session notes integration, and native connections to SimplePractice and TherapyNotes. Doxy.me offers larger group sessions (10 vs 6 participants) and was named G2's Easiest to Use Winner in 2025. Both provide secure, browser-based video without requiring patient accounts or downloads.

sections.heading: Which Platform for Which Practice?
sections.content: Doxy.me is ideal for budget-conscious solo practitioners who want free HIPAA-compliant telehealth, or multi-disciplinary practices with non-mental-health providers. Thera-LINK is better for therapists who value the therapeutic environment from first click, want EHR integration with SimplePractice or TherapyNotes, or appreciate features designed by fellow clinicians.

recommendations.when: Budget is a primary concern and free telehealth is essential, you need larger group sessions (up to 10), or you're a multi-specialty practice
You want a therapy-specific platform, value customizable calming waiting rooms for anxious clients, or use SimplePractice/TherapyNotes and want integration
You need reliable, browser-based HIPAA telehealth - both are solid choices for individual therapy sessions

faqs.q: Is Doxy.me's free plan really enough for therapy?
faqs.a: For many solo therapists, yes. Doxy.me's free plan includes HIPAA compliance, BAA, virtual waiting room, and standard video quality. You only need paid plans for HD video, screen sharing, or group calls beyond 1:1 sessions.

faqs.q: What makes Thera-LINK's waiting room special?
faqs.a: Thera-LINK's waiting room is designed for therapeutic environments - you can customize it with calming images, relaxation videos, or grounding exercises. This helps anxious clients settle before sessions start, unlike generic 'please wait' screens.

faqs.q: Do patients need to create accounts for either platform?
faqs.a: No. Both Doxy.me and Thera-LINK are browser-based and require no patient accounts, downloads, or installations. Patients simply click a link to join their session.
Thera-LINK has native integration with SimplePractice for scheduling coordination. Doxy.me has limited EHR integrations. If SimplePractice integration is important, Thera-LINK is the better choice.
